acs.text:
Given default `wikilinks` configuration, when `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` is converted, then the output is `

read the guide

`.
Given default configuration, when `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` and `[[Getting Started]]` are converted, then both `href` values are equal.
Given default configuration, when `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` is converted, then the output contains no `[[`, no `]]` and no `|`.

Given default configuration, when `[[Getting Started | read the guide]]` is converted, then the output is `

read the guide

`.
Given default configuration, when `[[Getting Started|  read the guide  ]]` is converted, then the output equals the output for `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]`.

Given `base_url='/wiki/'`, `end_url='.html'` and `html_class='myclass'`, when `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` is converted, then the output is `

read the guide

`.

Given `html_class=''`, when `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` is converted, then the output is `

read the guide

`.

Given a custom `build_url` that records its first argument, when `[[Getting Started|read the guide]]` is converted, then the recorded argument is `Getting Started` and the `href` is the value it returned.

Given default configuration, when `[[Getting Started]]` is converted, then the output is `

Getting Started

`.
Given default configuration, when `[[ ]]` is converted, then the output is the same as before this change (the empty wikilink is dropped and no link is created).

questions.title: Empty label or empty target
questions.question: What should `[[Page|]]` and `[[|Label]]` produce?
questions.options: (a) `[[Page|]]` links with the target as text, `[[|Label]]` is dropped (b) both are left as literal text (c) both are dropped like `[[ ]]` (d) Other

questions.title: More than one pipe
questions.question: How should `[[A|B|C]]` be handled?
questions.options: (a) target `A`, label `B|C` (b) target `A`, label `B`, rest ignored (c) not recognized, left as literal text (d) Other

questions.title: Characters allowed in the label
questions.question: Which characters may a label contain (for example `.`, `,`, `!`, `'`, `&`, `<`)?
questions.options: (a) any text except `]` and `|` (b) same characters as the target (c) any text except `]]` (d) Other
